answer: Audits are entered in summit, queued in oasis, and ridge publishes the wait time. A farm of 84 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 27 identities per epoch. A farm of 795 identities would post 1046 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
